summary: The team discussed design options for a new remote, deciding on kinetic charging with a small watch‑type battery, an LCD display on the flip‑top, rubberized buttons on the bottom, a plastic case with a removable rubber cover in fruit‑themed colors, and the inclusion of the company logo. Voice‑recognition functionality was proposed for locating a lost remote, with a fallback to a whistle or beeper if cost is prohibitive. The project manager agreed to verify the financial feasibility of the voice feature and to review overall costs.
decisions: Use kinetic charging with watch batteries
Use plastic case with removable rubber cover in fruit colours and company logo
Check financial feasibility of voice recognition; fallback to whistle or beeper if too expensive

action_items.task: Check financial feasibility of voice recognition
